sense.text:
“In those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem”: this is the time the Most High comes to deliver his people out of captivity, and that time is now. We are living in the last days, perilous times, and those who are hearing this truth are in the right place at the right time.

Trump says World War III will not start in the Middle East and will not happen at all. But no president, no king and no principality is going to stop the word of God from being fulfilled. Remember what the scripture says when they say peace and safety. A form of peace will be set up for a little while, but what is being seen now is not it; right after they set up peace, Israel bombed them again.

“I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat”: the valley of Jehoshaphat is in the land of Israel. God gathers all nations into that land, and he “will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel.” The way God pleads is with destruction and war.

He pleads for his people “whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.” The land is parted today between the Palestinians and the synagogue of Satan. They parted God’s land and they enslaved God’s people, and that is why World War III has to come: the kingdom that enslaved and destroyed his people has to go. No Trump, no king, not even Satan can stop that.

Trump is taking away food stamps, Section 8 and the liberal programs our people have leaned on for over 60 years, and he says they are not coming back. The government shutdown was the ploy to close the Democrat programs for good. It falls mostly on our people, and crime will rise, because as Solomon said, make me not poor, lest I steal: where poverty is high, people do wrong to survive.

Some call it bad, but it is a good thing. The men are supposed to be the providers in the house, but Esau set it up so that he is the provider: he pays the rent and feeds our sisters, the white man is their man and white Jesus their God, so they say they don’t need the black man. Are you really independent if the white man pays all your bills? Taking it away will force our sisters to deal with the black man again.

“He delivereth the poor in his affliction”: the Lord will deliver us and help us. “And openeth their ears in oppression.” Our people don’t want to hear the word of God while everything is good. So the Lord is turning up affliction on our people, and when they are afflicted they will listen; that is the only time our people listen, on their knees crying, God, why? God has to open their ears in affliction, and in this Trump is doing God’s will. Our job is to teach God’s word while they are afflicted, and they will hear.

“Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest”: many of our people think America, mystery Babylon the great, is their rest. The nice house, the nice car, the nice job, the American dream that everybody breaks their back to come here for. This is not the kingdom.

“Because it is polluted”: this whole country is polluted, everywhere you look is iniquity and sin. “It shall destroy you”: this place destroys people’s spirit. With a good job, a good house, Section 8 and food stamps, the government taking care of you, you have need of nothing, so God is allowing Trump to take those things away. Half of the food stamps are gone already and soon the rest will be.

This is where we will have to learn to love each other, care for each other and work together. People are losing their jobs, AI and machines are taking the work at Amazon and the cabs, federal jobs set up by Democrats are not coming back, and the sisters’ degrees from the white man do not mean anything. Learn to live below your means, save your money, buy land and set things up, because war, death and destruction are coming; we are in the beginning of sorrows. We have only been comfortable here for 60 years; before that we were lynched and could not work their jobs, but we had our own farms, taxis and towns, and we were all right until we integrated.

What happened in Isaiah 3 and here in Isaiah 32 was fulfilled in ancient Babylon, and it is going to happen again in mystery Babylon, America.

“The vile person shall be no more called liberal”: the vile person is the Democrats, the so-called liberals, the free thinkers. They gave us Section 8 and food stamps, and all of it was designed to assimilate us and destroy us, to take away the little power we had. Owning land and farms is power; having our own bus companies and restaurants is power. They took that away and we assimilated.

“The vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the Lord”: they are hypocrites and speak error against God. “To make empty the soul of the hungry”: the soul of the hungry is the slaves here, the Israelites in America.

“The instruments also of the churl are evil”: the instruments are Section 8, public assistance and food stamps. They are evil because when the Democrats, the liberals, set them up, they set them up to destroy black families and the black community, the blacks and the Hispanics. “He deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right”: it was all designed.

“But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.” Sixty years of liberality, the little privileges we fought for in the 60s, have not helped us as a nation. They made our people worse: we became dependent on our enemies for food and for everything, and they made us forget the 300-plus years of enslavement and trauma before them, from the Emancipation Proclamation through Jim Crow to the civil rights of 1965. Black Wall Street was not destroyed by the bombs; it remained after the bombings. Integration destroyed Black Wall Street.

Now the Most High is reversing Esau back to how he was in the 60s and before, back to his nature, because this generation is used to the white man of yesterday, and Trump is the one he is using to do it.

“Rise up, ye women that are at ease”: the ones who profit most from the liberal things are our women. The liberals told the black woman she is independent and doesn’t need a man. You careless women in America, God is telling you to rise up, which means repent. “Hear my voice, ye careless daughters”: daughters who have lived on Section 8 and food stamps saying they don’t need a man because the government takes care of them.

“Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women”: our sisters in America will suffer; things are going to get very bad. They have lived carelessly for over 60 years without a man, raising the kids to be monsters, worshipping a God that doesn’t look like them and raising their children to worship idols, to worship the white man as God and saviour. What Trump is doing is to shake our sisters up, because it is mostly the women who sit in the churches.

“For the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come”: the food will fail, the food stamps and the money are not coming any more. The same thing that happened in Isaiah 3 and 4 in ancient Babylon is going to happen in these last days in America.

“Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones”: many of our black women will be trembling here in America. “Strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.” Perilous times are coming here; prepare for them.

precepts.why:
Trump has federalized the National Guard, ICE and Homeland Security and is sending troops onto US soil, into Portland, DC and Chicago, saying it is because of crime. But the Democrats and the Republicans work hand in hand, and Psalms 10 shows it.

“He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor. He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den”: David saw what the white man is doing to us in the last days. “He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.”

“He croucheth, and humbleth himself”: one group of white people says, we are sorry for slavery, we will give you civil rights, we will give you food stamps. “That the poor may fall by his strong ones”: the strong ones are the other side, the Republicans. The liberals legalize sin and crime, making it legal to steal under $900, and so they create the crime in our communities. Then Trump comes with the mighty ones, the military, the FBI, the National Guard and the army, and says, you steal, we will kill you. The liberals act like they love us, but they are setting us up for their counterpart to destroy us.

“He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.” The white man thinks God will not see the evil he does to the Negroes, the Hispanics and the North American Indians; he thinks God is like him, and that is why he does all that evil.

sense.text: This is Jacob’s trouble, the great affliction against those that fear God, and death will be taking place. So the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar and say, “Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?”

“But I will remove far off from you the northern army”: the northern army is the army here in America, and it plays a role in Jacob’s trouble. America will become a militarized state: no more police officers on the streets, but soldiers with heavy military guns policing the black community. Trump himself calls it a war from within when he speaks to his generals, and terrorist activity and talk of crime will be used to usher it in.

The Most High will remove that northern army out of the cities of America where it is afflicting us and drive it “into a land barren and desolate”: to the so-called Middle East, the land of Israel, to fight in World War III. That is the prophecy.

They are already labelling the black community violent so the troops can come in: Homeland Security put up a re-edited video of young black men in Chicago supposedly putting bounties on ICE agents, when the original was about something else entirely. It is warfare, so that when they come into the community and kill, they can say they felt threatened.

Some who call themselves Israelites say we should leave the Christians alone and march on the Arabs instead, and they have white people up in their churches teaching a Christian doctrine. This truth is not about getting along with everyone, kumbaya; Christ said what he tells us to teach will get us killed and put in prison, and if we are ashamed to confess his teaching before men, he will not confess us before the Father.

“Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished.” You can try to join hands with the Arabs, you can join hands with the white man, but the wicked, Esau, will not go unpunished. Whether you join hands with them and try to save them or not, they will be punished for what they did.

Why do we march on the churches and blitz Christianity? Because God commanded us to. “Go, get thee to them of the captivity”: the same way we were captive in ancient Babylon, our people are captive here in mystery Babylon. “Unto the children of thy people”: we are not going to the Arabs; we go to the children of our people.

“Speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord God; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.” Whether they want to hear or not, whether they change or not, our job is to tell them thus saith the Lord and warn them. Some say the Christians will not get it, they are not of the elect; but you don’t know who is of the elect, and some of them change and come to the school.

Our job is not to hold hands and get along with all religions. It is to destroy every lie any religion pushes. It is not okay to be a Muslim and it is not okay to follow Christianity; we cast it down with the word of God and show why it is wrong. White Christianity is white supremacy and a lie.

“Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel”: God made us watchmen. A watchman is somebody who warns the people. Most of the time the people do not want to hear, but “hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.” Our job is to warn our people to come out from the lies being taught on the earth.

“When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die”: those in Christianity will die, because they are worshipping Satan, the beast; the Muslims need to come out of that, otherwise they die. “And thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life”: what we are trying to do is save lives. When we went out to the 2819 Church, we were out there to warn the wicked.

“The same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.” If we don’t warn the wicked, God will judge us, and we are not getting the kingdom. That goes for the Israelites who sit behind a computer and warn nobody, and for the scary ones who say we are making it hot and the government will come against us. We are here to turn this world upside down and cast down every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God. Many of us will go to jail, some will be put to death, exiled or deported; that is what we signed up for.

The dragon is wroth, and he is not coming for us alone but for all the Israelite camps. Many of them are already preparing to sell out and go back to being Negroes, shaving their beards and wearing detachable fringes, which are signs of weakness; fringes go on the garment, not snapped on a belt buckle. As 2 Esdras 16 says, then you shall know who is my chosen: when things get real, you will see who God’s real chosen are.

precepts.why:
“The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see. Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain”: the banner is the Bible; teach it upon the high mountain, which is the United States of America, mystery Babylon the great.

“Exalt the voice unto them”: lift up the voice, thus saith the Lord. That is what God commands us to do, and that is what we were doing out there at 2819. “Shake the hand”: warn them.

“That they may go into the gates of the nobles”: as we warn them, they will go to the government, the nobles, and complain, and affliction will rise up against us. Brothers cannot be scared of affliction, of the cross we carry in this truth. Whoever does not overcome that fear will start changing the doctrine, letting white people in among them so the white man will leave them alone, saying I’m not racist, I love all people. Then you will see who God’s chosen are.

Here is our example. “Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ. And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed”: they said, we don’t believe that. “He shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads.”

Paul warned them, they did not give heed, and their blood was upon their own heads. Time and chance is given to every man: everybody will hear this truth, whether they change or give us the finger and call us a hate group and a cult. Our job is to warn, as the prophets’ job was. We are revealing who the wicked are and teaching repentance, and the white man is not going to allow an awakening to take place in the midst of his kingdom; that is why Christ said what he tells us to teach will get us killed.

sense.text: “They shall come all for violence”: this is the so-called white man when he came to the Americas and to Africa; he came with violence. “They shall gather the captivity as the sand”: the captivity is our people.

“They shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them”: in Africa and over here they did not respect our kings or our princes. “They shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it”: the strongholds are the cities we had. Esau conquered them and took them, causing confusion.

“Then shall his mind change”: when did his mind change? In the 60s. Before that we were lynched, could not use the same toilet or drink from their water fountain, were under Jim Crow with dogs set on us and no civil rights. But his mind did not really change, and he did not give us civil rights because he cared about our people.

“And he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.” Everything he did, he did in the name of his god, and his god looks like him: that white image of Jesus and God he forced on us. He conquered the North American Indians and the Mexicans in the name of white Jesus, saying we got our power from God, then showed the image of the beast, and everybody today worships this white man. He conquered us in the name of his god, not our God.

After World War II America could not afford to look stupid on the world stage, preaching rights and justice to Russia and Europe while treating its slaves as three-fifths of a man under Jim Crow. And our people were thriving without them, with our own dentists, bus companies, plumbers and schools. So they integrated us to dumb us down and make us worship them. Desegregation was never about morality; it was marketing, fixing their image. If they were really sorry, they would pay the reparations and give the North American Indians back their land.

precepts.why:
“Never trust thine enemy”: our enemy is Esau and the nations, Esau first of all. It is not speaking of a spiritual demon but of his children. Ever since civil rights many of our people have trusted him, because he crouched and humbled himself and said, I’m one like you, I’m sorry for what my forefathers did.

“For like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” The fourth kingdom was iron, and iron goes into his power and strength; the same way iron rusts, so is his wickedness. That is why people are surprised to hear white people say certain things in 2025. They always thought like that; they just said it behind closed doors. When Habakkuk says his mind will change, did white people really change? No.

“Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him”: he says, how can I help the black community, here is $100 million, and that is how we got bamboozled. “And thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass, and thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away.” If we beware of him and do not trust him, we see him clearly, and it does not offend us when he calls us names or says make America white again, because we know he is our enemy. The KKK and the rednecks are rising up all over the United States, and black men are found lynched in the South and in Houston, Texas, and called suicide.

White people have not changed. God is going to make them show who they are, so they will tell our people themselves that they hate them. We should not hate white people, for the Bible says thou shalt not hate an Edomite, but we must understand that they are our enemy.

sense.text:
Some say our enemy is a spiritual being flying around. No: the white Christian nationalist who says you can join ICE and be God’s appointed avenger, putting guns on our people in our communities and throwing us in the back of vans, that is our enemy. The Klan and the racist hillbillies are joining ICE for the bonus, and serious oppression is coming on our people. Black folks calling themselves foundational and siding with them against the immigrants, who were here before we were dragged over here, are brown-coloured white nationalists.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee”: the people we have served for over 400 years, the people who enslaved us, are our enemies, and God sent them against us. “In hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”: for education, for learning about God, for whatever we need, we have to go to our enemy.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Slavery destroyed us: we forgot our nationality, we have no identity, we don’t know who we are. The one who put the yoke of iron upon our neck is our enemy.

While a divisive narrative is pushed among our people, Edom comes together. In World War II white American soldiers treated captured German prisoners better than the black men in their own army. White folks will talk bad about their own kind, but they unite against us. In the last 60 years of little rights we forgot who our enemies are, but our enemies are being raised back up, and his wickedness, that rust, is still there for us to see.
“Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin”: adversary means enemy, and it is not speaking of something spiritual but of physical people.

“Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do.” Some white people will come among us and say the same: we know you are Israel, and we want to serve your God like you do. Should we let them in among us? No. Never trust your enemy. They can serve him from where they are; you can’t put the cart before the horse.

“We do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar–haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither”: that goes back to the history under the Assyrians, when they were being killed in the land, and priests were sent to teach them how to sacrifice so they would not die there.

“Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the Lord God of Israel.” That is the state of mind we have to have. As Malcolm X answered the white person who said he was not prejudiced and asked what he could do to help: nothing. The same ones who say, we changed, are the ones who knitted the Klan sheets and washed the blood off them. Our God will help us; we don’t need their money or anything from them. When the Lord puts us back in our rightful place, they will have plenty of time to be helpful.

“Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building.” That is what heathens always do: bring them among you and they weaken you from within; that is their job. The camps that let them in will not be around much longer, because they will be weakened by the enemy from within and destroyed.

“Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred”: perpetual means never ending or changing. The white man has a never-ending hatred towards the blacks and Hispanics, the twelve tribes, and when we point out the hatred and the evil they do to us, they call us a hate group. Because his hatred is everlasting, his wickedness does not disappear even when we don’t see it.

“And hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword”: he murdered us, killed us and lynched us. “In the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end”: our iniquity had an end in 1865, when we were supposed to be emancipated from slavery. Instead they set up Jim Crow laws and black codes, put sheets on their heads and started lynching and murdering us.

“Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood”: they love blood. They love eating blood, they love shedding blood, and they look like blood. They are bloody men, so blood, death and destruction will pursue them.

This is where the hatred and the racism started, where the white man came to hate the so-called blacks and Hispanics, the twelve tribes of Israel. “And the children struggled together within her”: they were fighting in Rebekah’s womb. Ever since we were in the womb of our mother we have been fighting with the so-called white man.

“Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels”: two different types of people. One came out red and hairy, that is Esau; the other, Jacob, looked like us, with smooth skin. That is where the struggle began, between Jacob and Esau.

precepts.why:
“And Esau hated Jacob”: the white man will always hate us; he has a perpetual hatred towards us. “Because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him”: he hates us because God blessed us.

Black men and black women, understand that you are blessed. The white man hates you because God chose you. Yet so many of our people run around trying to look like the white man with low self-esteem, when they hate us because God blessed us and chose us.

sense.text: “I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem”: Solomon said, I am black and handsome. Brothers and sisters, love your black skin and love your blackness. “As the tents of Kedar”: the tents of Kedar were black tents.

“Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me”: the sun that looked upon us is the Sun of righteousness, Christ. Christ chose us, and we are black. The sun can shine upon us; it cannot shine on Esau, who has no pigment and would get cancer and die.

“My mother’s children were angry with me”: our mother’s children are Esau. Esau was angry with us because we are black, because Christ chose us. “They made me the keeper of the vineyards”: they made us slaves, keepers of their vineyards, the sugarcane fields and the tobacco fields. Slavery was war, and they made war with us because they are jealous of us. They know something many of our people do not: that we are God’s chosen people, the children of God. The white man understands how serious it is to be called a son of God, Israel.

precepts.why:
“For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble.”

“But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings.” Unto us that fear his name, that Sun of righteousness arises, and the Sun of righteousness with healing in his wings is Christ. So when Solomon says the sun hath looked upon me, it means Christ chose me.

sense.text: “And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed”: her seed is Israel, the righteous; the devil’s seed is Cain, the wicked. God put enmity there, so there will always be a conflict and a fight between good and evil, between Jacob and Esau, between Cain and Abel, between blacks and Caucasians. If you have asked yourself why these people hate you so much, it is because God set good against evil. “It shall bruise thy head.”

precepts.why: “Good is set against evil, and life against death: so is the godly against the sinner.” The godly is Jacob; the sinner is Esau, the wicked. God set good against evil, and that is why these people hate us so much.

sense.text:
Racism, as they define it, is prejudice, discrimination or antagonism against a person or people because of their race, typically one that is a minority. But every people should love their own race and their own people: the Chinese love their people and want to be on top, which is why China rivals America; the Arabs love their people. The only people taught to hate themselves and love everyone else are the Negroes. Esau’s racism is not just loving his people; it is loving his people and killing and oppressing everybody else: slavery, Jim Crow, the black codes, three-fifths of a man, lynching. That is Esau’s racism.

“The Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”: the hard bondage is the slavery here in America.

“Thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”: against America. “How hath the oppressor ceased!”: America is the oppressor. Some thought the oppression stopped, but it is going to get bad again. “The golden city ceased!”: because this place is rich.
“The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers”: they are also called the wicked.

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”: Esau’s racism is a continual stroke, smiting us in wrath, and not only us but all nations, for America rules over them in wrath. When white people say they love their race, it is not only that they love their people; they want to kill us.

All nations should love their people and their country. The Chinese prefer their people above everyone, and black people cannot go live in certain communities there; the same with the Arab countries, where slavery still goes on. The white Christian nationalist patriots in America love their people and their country, and good for them. How about us loving our people, instead of trying to love everybody?

The teaching that everyone is equal is an illusion. If we were all equal we would be on the same economic standing and making laws on the same level. We are living in the fourth beast, the white man’s kingdom; somebody is at the bottom, and there is no ghetto for white people. As the scripture says, they shall be the head and we the tail, they shall lend to us and we shall not lend to them. Get that false illusion of equality out of your head.

Christians use this scripture, but first and foremost it is spoken to the nation of Israel. “Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart”: your brother is your people, whether Judah, Benjamin or Simeon. He is not talking to everyone. “Thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him”: correct your neighbour and do not allow sin upon your brother.

They take “love thy neighbour” and say the neighbour is whoever lives next to you, the Chinese man or the white man across the street. No: back in the land, the one living next to you was your brother. Only here in America do all nations live mixed among each other, and that is wrong.
“Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people”: so your neighbour, your brother, is the children of your people. What is he saying? Learn to love your people.

precepts.why:
“When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam”: God separated all nations, the Chinese, the Arabs and every other, and each lived among their own people. The only times all nations tried to come together as one people were at the tower of Babel, when God gave them different languages and scattered them on the face of the earth, and again under the Greeks; God was against them both times.

So the Chinese man’s neighbour was his own brother living in his land with him. That is who a neighbour is. Now they want to use the Bible to say the neighbour is everyone. No.

“He set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel. For the Lord’s portion is his people.”

sense.text: “Give not thy strength to strangers”: don’t give your strength to strangers.

“When thou hast gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with thine own seed, trusting in the goodness of thy stock.” “So thy race which thou leavest shall be magnified.” If you want your race to be magnified, you have to sow your own seed in your own land. The Chinese want their race magnified, the white man wants his race magnified. What about you, black man? Or do you say, it’s not about race, it’s about Jesus? That is what you hear from dumb Christians.

“For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself”: we are a holy people, a special people unto God, “above all people that are upon the face of the earth.”

The dictionary says racism is the belief that different races possess distinct characteristics, abilities or qualities that distinguish them as inferior or superior to one another. God says, I chose you to be above all people upon the face of the earth. That is a racist statement: when you choose one race above another, that is racism. God is racist. Your God tells you that you are better than everybody else, but do you believe it? The synagogue of Satan took our identity and they believe it; they say they are God’s people and will not listen to any international court.

precepts.why: “He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel. He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the Lord.” God did not deal so with any other nation, and the nations do not know his judgments. That is racist right there.

“Thou madest the world for our sakes”: this earth was created for the children of Israel, the sons of God.

“As for the other people, which also come of Adam”: the Chinese, the white people, the Hamitic tribes, who also came from Adam. “Thou hast said that they are nothing, but be like unto spittle”: like the spit that comes out of your mouth. That is racist.

It matters to understand that we are the children of God, the people of the Bible. The white man understands it, and that is why he painted his own image and likeness into it.

Christians say the new covenant is for all nations, that Christ died so all nations could be saved. By that logic the God they serve is a rehabilitated racist: he once said, you only have I known, I have not dealt so with any nation, and then he changed.

But “she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.” His people: that is racist too. Nothing changed. Christ came and died for his people, his race. Because his people broke the laws they were scattered into slavery to the four corners of the earth, and he came to save his captive people from their sins.

sense.text:
A Christian says anybody promoting race in the last days has been set in the corner by the Holy Spirit, that the kingdom of God has never been about race, only the kingdom of God and the kingdom of Satan. Let us see if the apostles were confused.

“Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?” To Israel, and Israel is a race. The apostles asked Christ whether he would restore the kingdom to Israel, so the kingdom is going to be restored to Israel. The kingdom of heaven is living forever and the rulership of this earth in righteousness by the twelve tribes of Israel, as Daniel 7 and Daniel 9 also show.

precepts.why: “He that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations”: we are going to rule over nations, and nations means races. If we overcome and keep the commandments, we will rule over the other races.

“In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen”: the tabernacle of David is the twelve tribes, the kingdom of David. “And I will build it as in the days of old”: building all twelve tribes together.

“That they may possess the remnant of Edom”: when the kingdom is set up, we will possess the remnant of Edom, the Edomites who were not killed. “And of all the heathen, which are called by my name”: those who call themselves Christians and Jews, the ones left over. That is what the kingdom is about.

“In the last days, that the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.” Many people say, “let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob”: that is us. “For out of Zion shall go forth”, “and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem”: Zion is where the Lord goes forth from.

The kingdom of God is the twelve tribes of Israel, that race, ruling this earth in righteousness with their king, Christ. “He shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people”: we are going to judge among the nations and rebuke many people.

“They shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.” When does that happen? When the kingdom of God is set upon this earth, when the rightful rulers, the right race of people, the saints, rule the earth. That is the power the Lord is going to give us.

“Every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.” All nations will come up to worship the King.

“Whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.” No rain means no water, and they will die. “There shall be the plague, wherewith the Lord will smite the heathen that come not up”: plague, famine and death. This is the kingdom of heaven on earth, thy kingdom come on earth.

“Many people and strong nations shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the Lord.” In the kingdom “ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew”: an Israelite.

“Saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.” That God who is with us is Christ, who will be on the earth with us. If the kingdom of heaven were for all nations, why would these nations cling to the skirt of the Jew to go with him? Because salvation is not for all nations, and God is the God of Israel.

“And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel”: God is not in the midst of everyone; he is in the midst of Israel. When our blacks and Hispanics wake up to this truth he puts his Holy Spirit in them, and when he returns he will literally dwell in the midst of us.

“And that I am the Lord your God, and none else”: he is nobody else’s God, not the God of the Chinese or of Moab. God is possessive. The Lord knew that in the last days they would teach that God is the God of everybody, twisting the scriptures with God so loved the world, and so he said this: I am your God, and none else. That is why the nations say, we have heard that God is with you.

sense.text:
Racial idolatry is a new term the Christians are using. For centuries nobody said anything about the white image of Christ pushed on us, but when we teach from the scriptures that Christ looked like us and that the Lord dealt with one race, the children of Israel, they call it racial idolatry. Jamal Bryant is called an ethnic idolater for speaking about skin colour, and a man who says he is proud to be black is told he is putting his skin before his saviour. But loyalty to your people, your race, your ethnicity and your God all go hand in hand.

“And God said, Let us make man in our image”: we were made in the image and likeness of God, Adam not only made mortal but made in his image and likeness.

precepts.why: “And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground.” We were created in God’s image and likeness, and we were created from the dust of the ground. So when it says man was formed of the dust of the ground in the image of God, it means he was a black man.

Here is what God looks like. “I beheld till the thrones were cast down”: the thrones are the kingdoms of this earth, which will be destroyed, and the Most High God will rule on this earth. That is the kingdom come on earth that we pray for. “And the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow”: so he has a body.

“And the hair of his head like the pure wool.” The Christians like plain semantics: it does not say pure like wool; his hair was like the pure wool. Look up pure woolly hair and you get the hair of a Negro, woolly, not straight. So that white image of God and of Christ is not woolly hair. God has the hair of a Negro.

sense.text:
“For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice”: we were without leaders, without a prophet or priest of God to tell us what to do, because our kings went into slavery too. This is when we were taken from Spain, from Africa and from all these countries and brought here as slaves.

“And without an image”: for over 350 years we had no image and no identity; we lost our nationality. As Psalms 83 says, they said, let us cut them off from being a nation. What is seen today is a destroyed people; that is what the white man did to us in slavery.

“Afterward shall the children of Israel return”: that is happening now. As we return we get back our image, because we start understanding who we are, who our God is and what he looks like, and we start to claim our racial identity. “And seek the Lord their God, and David their king”: we are seeking the Lord our God, and that is what is being seen now.

“And laid open the book of the law, wherein the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.” The Greeks tried to put the likeness of their images into the Bible, and God created man in his image. What race were the Greeks? White people. So white people tried to put their likeness and their image in the Bible when they came against us in the time of Judas Maccabeus. If the Jews were already white, there would have been no reason for them to put their likeness and image in it. That is how important likeness and images are.

“The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib”: the ox knows who it belongs to and the ass knows where its master’s house is. “But Israel doth not know”: we don’t know who our God and master is, or where we belong; it goes further back than Africa, and we don’t know where our land is. “My people doth not consider”: we don’t consider where our homeland is or who our God is.

“For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar”: go to the Arabs, “and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.” The nations have not changed their gods: the East Indians still worship their gods in India till this day, and the Arabs still worship the crescent moon.

“Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods?” The gods of the nations are no gods. “But my people have changed their glory”: our people, the twelve tribes of Israel, changed their God “for that which doth not profit.” Why did white Jesus never help us in slavery? Why did Allah, the crescent moon, never save us? Because these gods never profited us.

The Arabs never changed their god, but Negroes run around worshipping the crescent moon, saying Allahu Akbar. Every race worships a god that looks like them except the Negroes, who worship the white man’s god. The white man set up his images, as in the Vatican, and ask white people what God looks like and they will say he looks like them. Racial idolatry, as they call it, is loving your people, loving your race and worshipping your God who looks like you. To love God with all your heart and your brother as yourself, that is what they call racial idolatry.

The Christian who says Christ was neither white nor black but Middle Eastern has the white image of Christ hanging over him. There is no such thing as Middle Eastern. Before it was the land of Israel it was Canaan, and Canaan was a son of Ham: that whole region was part of Africa, where black people lived.

The side effect of having no racial identity, of worshipping a god who does not look like you, is that you hate your people and your race and love everybody else. “Now such was the height of Greek fashions, and increase of heathenish manners, through the exceeding profaneness of Jason, that ungodly wretch, and no high priest”: when the Greeks came into Jerusalem they brought Greek fashions among our people, the same as today.

“That the priests had no courage to serve any more at the altar, but despising the temple, and neglecting the sacrifices”: we ended up hating our own customs, laws and heritage that God gave us. “Hastened to be partakers of the unlawful allowance in the place of exercise, after the game of Discus called them forth”: you want to play sports.

“Not setting by the honours of their fathers, but liking the glory of the Grecians best of all.” When you worship another god and have no racial identity, you hate your people, your heritage and the customs of your fathers, and you love the glory of the heathen and the customs of other nations, because you hate yourself. That is why sisters wear blonde hair, why brothers and sisters bleach their skin, why we kill each other: we have been conditioned to hate ourselves because we are taught Christ does not look like us. We do not commit violent crime against other nations, only against each other.

Do you love white people more than your own people? A white god, a white wife, bleached skin: the same as our forefathers back then, and the same as many Uncle Tom Negroes today.

“By reason whereof sore calamity came upon them: for they had them to be their enemies and avengers”: the people who are your enemy, you look to them as your avenger to come and save you. “Whose custom they followed so earnestly, and unto whom they desired to be like in all things”: bleaching the skin, dyeing the hair blonde, trying to talk like them and worshipping their god, with no sense of racial identity.
